title: automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap for private installer (helm + terraform modules)
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: when installing Redwood Private via the installer (Helm + Terraform), customers need a deterministic, auditable bootstrap flow for tenant RBAC and the minimal bootstrap service account. This PR automates creation of tenant-scoped Roles/ClusterRoles, the bootstrap service account, and the initial tenant bindings via Terraform outputs and Helm templates so the installer can perform a non-interactive bootstrap.

What this PR does: 
- Adds Helm templates for tenant-scoped Role/RoleBinding and a templated ClusterRoleBinding for installer-managed bootstrap flows (templates/rbac.yaml).
- Introduces a terraform module (terraform/modules/rbac) that emits a stable "bootstrap_sa" service account name and the minimal list of permissions required for installer operations.
- Wiring in the private-installer chart: values to enable automated bootstrap and example values in examples/private-installer/values.yaml.
- Adds a small CLI helper script scripts/bootstrap/create-tenant-bootstrap.sh used by the installer to apply generated manifests when running in air-gapped/on-prem modes.
- Documentation: docs/private-installer/rbac-bootstrap.md with the flow and required audit/KMS considerations.

Checklist: 
- [x] Helm templates added and unit-tested with helm template checks
- [x] Terraform module added and documented
- [x] Installer can consume outputs (example usage added to examples/)
- [x] Security review with SRE/infosec (see comments)
- [x] E2E smoke tested in private dev cluster (non-prod)

Notes and rationale: 
- We intentionally keep ClusterRole usage minimal and scoped; most permissions are Role-scoped per-tenant to preserve tenant isolation. The ClusterRoleBinding generated is only for the installer service account during the bootstrap window and is destroyed/rotated by the installer after successful setup.
- The terraform module exposes explicit outputs (bootstrap_sa, bootstrap_sa_namespace, bootstrap_policy_rules) that the installer can use to render Helm values for templated RBAC or to apply raw manifests in air-gapped mode.

References: Linear ENG-3421 (private installer RBAC), internal RFC: rfc/2025-06-rbac-bootstrap.md, support ticket SUP-1182.
